propositions: Structured-output validation and recovery must execute through one Pydantic Agent operation with shared request budget, with retry context preserving complete input, output, and history without truncation
Retry behavior must include deterministic extraction, fallback eligibility, terminal refusal filtering, typed exhaustion, and final-failure artifacts while maintaining answering-model provenance
Successful operations report complete Pydantic run usage exactly once; fallback and downgrade candidates remain as trace or journal events rather than competing usage counters
Bespoke structured-output retry loop removal requires compatibility suite and Anthropic/Bedrock cache canaries to pass; live canary deferred due to credential unavailability in autonomous session
All mode='structured' consumers (library, CLI, MCP, in-tree callers) must route through the one-operation facade with no out-of-scope parity gaps
